summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd., an Israeli company, filed a Form 6-K incorporating an updated legal opinion (Exhibit 5.1) into its existing Form F-3 registration statement. The filing follows shareholder approval to increase authorized share capital from 30 million to 500 million ordinary shares. The opinion covers the validity of up to 31,047,068 ordinary shares for resale by selling shareholders, including shares from a July 6, 2026 private placement and associated warrants. This is a routine securities filing, not a special situation event.
